question: ‘Drawing From the City’ is a visual autobiography of which of the following Indian folk artists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Teju Behun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Drawing From the City **is a **richly detailed drawing**, **featuring Teju’s self-taught style **of lines and **dots celebrates the life of a gentle**, **spirited woman **who continues **to paint her way through difficult times**.
 
• This book is **published in 2012**.
 
• **Teju Buhun's **Drawing From the City is an incredible visual autobiography with intricately detailed hand drawings **showing the adventures **from **Buhun's childhood**, **her marriage**, and **her life **as a **travelling musician**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamini Roy **was an Indian painter. Roy was honoured with the State award of Padma Bhushan in 1954. Roy remains one of the most famous pupils of Abanindranath Tagore, another praised Indian artist, and instructor.
 
• **Bhajju Shyam is an Indian artist, belonging to the Gond-Pardhaan community** of Madhya Pradesh. He was awarded India's fourth highest civilian award the Padma Shri in 2018.
 
• **Baua Devi is a Mithila painting artist **from Jitwarpur village of Madhubani District in Bihar. Mithila painting is an ancient folk art that originated in the region.
